title: Until Dawn 2 Release Date, Preorders and Digital Deluxe Edition Explained
description: Until Dawn 2 launches January 28, 2027 on PS5. Here are the preorder date, Digital Deluxe Edition details and key State of Play reveals.
body:
Until Dawn 2 has moved from a broad 2027 window to a firm **January 28, 2027** release date on PlayStation 5.

Firesprite used Sony’s September State of Play to confirm the date, reveal that preorders open September 10, and detail both preorder bonuses and a Digital Deluxe Edition.

The sequel is a standalone choice-driven horror story following the paranormal-video crew Dead True as they investigate Akishima Island, with AdHoc Studio working with Firesprite on the narrative.
author: Rouane Mounssif
imageAlt: A translucent skeletal apparition glows green and orange in a dark, rain-soaked forest scene from Until Dawn 2.

contentBlocks.text: **Until Dawn 2 launches January 28, 2027 on PlayStation 5.** Sony and Firesprite have not announced PS4, Xbox, Nintendo Switch 2 or PC versions. The sequel is designed as a standalone story rather than a direct continuation that requires players to know every outcome from the original Until Dawn.
contentBlocks.heading: Until Dawn 2 release date and platform

contentBlocks.text: Preorders open **September 10, 2026** for both the Standard and Digital Deluxe Editions. Sony says preordering either version unlocks a group of Dr. Hill-themed bonuses, including two outfits and collectible Dr. Hill bobbleheads that can be found in the game.
contentBlocks.heading: When do Until Dawn 2 preorders open?

contentBlocks.text: The Digital Deluxe Edition adds the **Y2K Neon Vibes Pack**, which gives the eight members of Dead True alternate neon outfits, plus a feature called **Diorama of Death** that lets players revisit unlocked character-outcome scenes from different angles. Sony has not yet published pricing in the announcement, so the safest comparison for now is based on content rather than cost.
contentBlocks.heading: What is in the Digital Deluxe Edition?

contentBlocks.text: The new cast belongs to **Dead True**, a paranormal-video team whose investigation takes them to Akishima Island. Firesprite says the story keeps the series’ defining choice-and-consequence structure, where decisions affect relationships, clues and who makes it through the story. AdHoc Studio, known for Dispatch, is collaborating on the narrative and character writing, while Peter Stormare returns as Dr. Hill.
contentBlocks.heading: What is Until Dawn 2 about?

conclusion: Until Dawn 2 now has the three details players are most likely to search before launch: a date, a preorder window and clear edition differences. Firesprite still has months to reveal more about the story and gameplay, but the January launch plan is now concrete.
